title: fix: persist Mouse Without Borders security key edits

confidence.rationale: The defect follows directly from the current guard, the setup caller runtime-only mutation, the reload path, and PBKDF2 exact string input.

proposed_comments.body:
**[P1] Qualify the settings parameter type so the application compiles**

`Settings` resolves to the referenced `Settings` namespace rather than the imported `MouseWithoutBorders.Class.Settings` type here, producing CS0118. Qualify the parameter type; this keeps the existing caller and method behavior unchanged.

```suggestion
        internal static bool TryApplySecurityKey(global::MouseWithoutBorders.Class.Settings settings, string newKey, out string error)
```

confidence.rationale: Compiler diagnostic at the unchanged upstream signature and exact production reference/type definitions exclude the localized persistence edit and private test source as the cause.
